issue.title: Upload worker (recordingSync.ts) on expo-file-system (net-new)
issue.body:
### Current state on main

- **Absent:** `src/services/recordingSync.ts`, and the `repository.ts` helpers it needs (`getPendingRecordings`, `updateRecordingSyncStatus`) — those come from #98.
- Schema already models upload state (`src/db/schema.ts:80`): `sync_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'`, `upload_error TEXT`, `blob_key TEXT`, `local_file_path`, plus `idx_rec_pending ON recordings(sync_status) WHERE sync_status != 'uploaded'` (`:96`).
- `getPendingUploadCount()` already exists (`queries.ts:355`) counting `is_latest = 1 AND sync_status != 'uploaded'`.
- The general sync service (`src/services/sync.ts`) handles data sync with a `retrySyncStep` retry/error pattern worth mirroring.

### Problems / why (anti-patterns to avoid)

[PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) `src/services/recordingSync.ts`:
- Imports **`@env`** (`import { API_BASE_URL } from '@env'`) — removed on main; the baseline uses `getApiBaseUrl()` from `src/config/apiBaseUrl.ts`.
- Uses **`react-native-fs`** and **reconstructs absolute paths**: `deriveAbsolutePath(rel) => ${RNFS.DocumentDirectoryPath}/Projects/${rel}` — path coupling that breaks if storage layout changes.
- Reads columns that don't exist in the PR #82 anti-pattern schema (`relative_path`, `project_unit_id`) instead of `local_file_path`/`bible_text_id`.
- Sets status to `'syncing'`/`'synced'`, inconsistent with the schema's `'pending'`/`'uploaded'` convention.

### Target design

```bash
# expo-file-system already added in #94; reuse it
```

```ts
// src/services/recordingSync.ts
// status transitions: 'pending' -> 'uploading' -> 'uploaded' | 'failed'
export interface UploadResult { uploaded: number; failed: number; }

export async function syncPendingRecordings(token: string): Promise<UploadResult> {
 const pending = await getPendingRecordings(); // is_latest=1 AND sync_status != 'uploaded'
 for (const rec of pending) {
 await setRecordingSyncStatus(rec.id, 'uploading');
 try {
 const blobKey = await uploadRecording(rec, token); // reads rec.local_file_path directly
 await markRecordingUploaded(rec.id, blobKey); // sync_status='uploaded', store blob_key
 } catch (e) {
 await markRecordingFailed(rec.id, message(e)); // sync_status='failed', upload_error=...
 }
 }
}
```

- **No path reconstruction:** read `rec.local_file_path` (set by #94/#98); use `expo-file-system` only to confirm existence / read for upload.
- **Base URL:** `getApiBaseUrl()` (never `@env`).
- **Token:** accept it as a parameter (per #88 contract) — no global singleton dependency.
- **Logging:** use `logger.create('RecordingSync')`; reuse a retry pattern like `sync.ts`'s `retrySyncStep` (bounded attempts, backoff) and persist `upload_error` on final failure.
- **Concurrency guard:** single-flight (no overlapping runs).
- The exact request/response contract is defined in #102 (C4) against fluent-api PR #188.

### Implementation steps

1. Implement `getPendingRecordings`, `setRecordingSyncStatus`, `markRecordingUploaded`, `markRecordingFailed` in `repository.ts` (coordinate with #98).
2. Implement `src/services/recordingSync.ts` with the transitions above, `getApiBaseUrl()`, token param, bounded retries/backoff, single-flight guard, logger.
3. Upload via `multipart/form-data` (or the contract from #102), reading `local_file_path`; store returned `blob_key`.
4. Surface a result summary for the UI (#101).
5. Unit tests with mocked repository + `fetch` + `expo-file-system`: success path, failure→`failed`+`upload_error`, retry/backoff, single-flight.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `recordingSync.ts` uses `expo-file-system` + `getApiBaseUrl()`; **no** `@env`, **no** `react-native-fs`.
- [ ] Reads `local_file_path` directly — no absolute-path reconstruction.
- [ ] Status transitions are `pending → uploading → uploaded|failed`; `upload_error` persisted on failure; `blob_key` stored on success.
- [ ] Accepts the auth token as a parameter (per #88); single-flight; bounded retries with backoff; logs via `logger`.
- [ ] Covered by unit tests (success, failure, retry, single-flight).

### Test plan / verification

```bash
npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci
```

- Tests default `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9999` via `jest.env.cjs`; **no live API required** — mock `fetch`/repo/file-system.
- Do **not** use `FLUENT_USER_EMAIL`.

### Out of scope

- Server contract details (#102), UI surfacing (#101), schema/repo for takes (#98/#99), token accessor (#88).

### Links

- Epic: #117
- Related: #88 (token), #94 (file-system), #98/#99 (schema/repo), #101 (UI), #102 (server contract)
- Anti-pattern: [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) `src/services/recordingSync.ts`

|---|---|---|
| Live DevQA against a deployed verse-audio API | fluent-api [#224](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/224) is not on `main` / not deployed; CI uses mocked `fetch` / FS / DB only | Merge/deploy fluent-api #224 (or chosen API); then device QA when real uploads run |
| Full #98 multi-take repository surface (`addRecordingTake`, take listing, etc.) | #98 still open; this PR adds **minimal** `getPendingRecordings` + status writers needed by the worker only | [#98](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/98) |
| Null / unresolved `bibleTextId` at record time | Recordings schema requires `bible_text_id`; gap is in Record-tab sync/lookup before a row exists | [#177](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/177) |
| Sync page Pause/Resume/Cancel/Sync Now UI | Explicitly out of scope for #100 | [#151](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/151) / [#152](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/152) |
